text: With the focus of the Clan, plantain bundles, marigold, raspberry clusters, thyme bundles, betony, juniper bunches, lungwort, tansy, dandelions, mallow, moss clumps, oak leaf bundles, burdock roots, blackberry clusters, ragwort, wild garlic, goldenrod, horsetail clumps, mullein, elder leaf bundles, cobwebs, daisies, rosemary clumps, doses of poppy seeds, and catmint piles were gathered.

As BugClan's leader gives their speech during the Gathering, Prancelaurel bellows with laughter at one of their jokes. Only... it wasn't a joke, apparently. Prancelaurel apologizes profusely, but the damage is already done. (BugClan relations worsened.)
Poolleaf boldly confesses to the entire Clan that she killed Saltknoll. Poolleaf claims that Saltknoll deserved to pay for what he did.
Nymphshine examines Yewstar's leg and reports that though everything seems to be healed, the weakness Yewstar has complained about is likely a permanent consequence of the injury.
